biotools.summary: FISHtoFigure is a software tool designed for the analysis of subcellular mRNA transcript colocalisation in smFISH data, facilitating automated spatial analysis of transcripts without requiring extensive computational expertise. It is used in conjunction with QuPath and designed to analyse mRNA abundance and co-expression.
